title: Sable and the Garden
author: Rafael Thackeray
blurb: Cyrus Underhill, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
